# Piney Creek Chop House

> Chop House in Bastrop, Texas. Steaks, seafood and cocktails in a brick-walled historic dining room with a piano bar.

- Phone: (512) 321-2135
- Address: 703 Chestnut St, Bastrop, TX 78602
- Areas: Bastrop, Smithville, Cedar Creek, Webberville, Paige
- Offers: Steaks; Starters and seafood; Cocktails and happy hour
- Rating: 4.4 from 527 Google reviews
